title: Birdsong - Rooftop cinema & skyline views
description:
Welcome to your Gulch retreat—just a 3-minute drive or easy walk to Broadway’s honky-tonks and Gulch dining.
Private rooftop deck with skyline movie screen & grill
3 bedrooms: king suite, queen bunks, ground-floor queen
2-car garage + free street parking
Chef-ready kitchen & fast Wi-Fi
Whether family getaway or work trip, soak in the views, stroll to coffee, then unwind under the stars.

The space
Highlights:
•	We own 8 units next to each other, larger groups please reach out. 
•	Private roof top deck with views, projector, grill and seating
•	Free parking in the 2 car garage
•	Walk Score 85 (walk to Gulch, cafes, dining, shopping, nightlife)
•	Fully equipped + stocked kitchen
•	5 minute drive to downtown Nashville

Perfect for larger groups or multiple families looking to travel together. Birdsong is equipped with custom kitchens and professional appliances, designer spa like baths with Italian tile and faucets, incredible lighting, soaring ceilings, unique and beautiful wall treatments, and rooftop decks with 360 degrees views of downtown. Book now and make this the choice for your next group trip or work getaway to Music city. 

Bed Setup for this home:
 
Master Bedroom (3rd Level): King Bed with suite Bathroom 
2nd Bedroom (3rd Level): 1 queen bunk bed- full bathroom right outside the room   
3rd Bedroom (1st Level): Queen with full bath right outside the bedroom

Unwind Luxury Vacations is the professional management company for this home, and committed to curating your 5-star experience.

Guest access
Full access to the unit plus rooftop lounge.
